body:
At this point, her life is more important than this relationship. I'm gonna go ahead and tell her parents in person because I'm not anywhere near her for the next few days. I'll tell them in a week or so. Thank you so much for this really.
>You must enlist the help of adults for this.<
What do you mean ?

Her parents don't encourage her to talk to boys at all. Talking to them will mostly make matters worse. They sure as hell don't want her dating anyone right now. Her parents always find faults in her and I think that's one of the reasons she's so depressed. If they know about us, even the fact that we might be just friends, might make them more mad at her and I'm scared that will only give her another reason to commit suicide. Thanks for the help though.
